app.home_unwritable: Message box of the desktop app. VRCINEMA_HOME is the name of an environment variable, keep it.
app.start_failed: Message box of the desktop app. Shown when the program cannot start; {path} is the log folder.
app.stop_too_slow: Printed to the console when the program quits, not to the log.
app.webview2_missing: Message box of the desktop app. A yes/no question; "Evergreen" is the name of the download version, keep it.
app.window_failed: Message box of the desktop app. Shown when the window cannot be created.
banner.channel_down: Notice at the top of the interface when the channel stopped.
banner.channel_down_reason: Notice at the top of the interface; {reason} is an error message of the program (already translated).
banner.dismiss: Close button of a notice (screen-reader label and tooltip).
banner.go_internet: Link in a notice to Settings → Internet.
banner.go_ticker: Link in a notice to the info ticker settings (Settings → Channel).
banner.go_tools: Link in a notice to Settings → Tools.
banner.go_update: Link in a notice to Settings → About, where the update is installed.
banner.go_upload: Link in a notice to Settings → Channel, where the upload speed is entered.
banner.label: Screen-reader name of the strip of notices at the top of the interface.
banner.link_over: Notice at the top of the interface (as an error): the viewers watching now times the stream's bitrate is more than the upload speed the owner entered. Nothing is blocked.
banner.link_warn: Notice at the top of the interface: the viewers watching now times the stream's bitrate comes close to the upload speed the owner entered. Nothing is blocked. {viewers} is a number.
banner.ticker_slow: Notice at the top of the interface. The info ticker is the text strip burned into the stream.
banner.tools_missing: Notice at the top of the interface. {tools} is a list of program names like yt-dlp, ffmpeg.
banner.tunnel_error: Notice at the top of the interface: the built-in Cloudflare tunnel is in an error state.
banner.tunnel_error_reason: Like banner.tunnel_error, with the reason (an already translated message).
banner.update: Notice at the top of the interface; {version} is a version number like 0.3.0.
banner.alarm_black: Notice at the top of the interface (error) while the alarm for a black picture on air is raised (Settings → Advanced).
banner.alarm_silence: Notice at the top of the interface (error) while the alarm for silence on air is raised (Settings → Advanced).
banner.go_advanced: Link in an alarm notice to the alarm settings (Settings → Advanced). Max ~24 characters.
drop.hint: New interface: shown over the whole window while files are dragged onto it.
drop.none: New interface: message after files were dropped on the window and none could be added.
drop.skipped: New interface: message after files were dropped on the window; some of them were not added.
errors.action_or_position: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Moving/approving a queue item with a malformed request; action, approve, reject, position are API field names — keep them.
errors.app_closing: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). The app window asked for something while the app shuts down.
errors.archive_lacks_file: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools install; {file} is a file name inside the archive.
errors.autostart_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: switching "start with Windows" failed; {detail} is the system error.
errors.backup_dir_failed: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools install; {path} is a folder.
errors.bad_address: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). The address of the video found for a viewer link has a backslash, a space or a control character (also an item error).
errors.bad_request: API error (panel player controls): generic text of the code bad_request; answers usually carry a more specific text.
errors.bad_scheme: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the link is not an http or https address (for example file: or ftp:).
errors.bad_start_time: API error (panel, app window notice). Panel: "Start at…" got a time in the past or too far ahead.
errors.bad_trim: API error (panel, app window notice). Panel: the trim dialog of a queued video got an invalid start or end point.
errors.block_not_found: API error (panel). The block to lift does not exist (already lifted).
errors.body_too_large: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Technical (request over 16 KB); the same English text in every language (API compatibility).
errors.busy: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): a second operation was started while one runs.
errors.cancelled: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the owner cancelled the Cloudflare login.
errors.cannot_block: API error (panel, app window notice). Panel: "Remove all from this viewer" with "Also block the device" for a viewer who sent no device key, so there is nothing to block.
errors.cannot_create_data_dir: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server start; {detail} is the system error.
errors.cannot_create_dir: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools install; a cause (system error) may follow after a colon.
errors.cannot_listen: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server start; {address} is host:port, {detail} the system error (port taken).
errors.cannot_lock_file: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server start; the lock keeps two servers from using one data folder.
errors.cannot_open_file: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server start; {detail} is the system error.
errors.cannot_replace_file: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools install; a cause (system error) may follow after a colon.
errors.cannot_write_file: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools install; a cause (system error) may follow after a colon.
errors.certificate_save_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): saving the login certificate failed; {reason} is the system error.
errors.checksum_entry_missing: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools download; {file} is a file name.
errors.checksum_mismatch: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools download; {expected} and {actual} are SHA-256 digests, keep them as they are.
errors.cloudflared_start: Tunnel error (app window, tunnel status and wizard): the cloudflared program would not start; {detail} is the system error.
errors.config_admin_password_missing: Error text printed to the console by the headless server or the setup command (also shown in the log). ADMIN_PASSWORD and .env are names, keep them.
errors.config_admin_password_weak: Error text printed to the console by the headless server or the setup command (also shown in the log). ADMIN_PASSWORD is a setting name; "zmien-mnie" is the example value in .env.example, keep it as it is.
errors.config_invalid_port: Error text printed to the console by the headless server or the setup command (also shown in the log). PORT is a setting name.
errors.config_session_secret: Error text printed to the console by the headless server or the setup command (also shown in the log). SESSION_SECRET is a setting name in the .env file, keep it.
errors.config_unknown_encoder: Error text printed to the console by the headless server or the setup command (also shown in the log). VIDEO_ENCODER is a setting name; {allowed} is a list of technical names.
errors.config_unknown_language: Error text printed to the console by the headless server or the setup command (also shown in the log). LANGUAGE is a setting name; {allowed} is a list of language codes.
errors.cookies_by_picker: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: the cookies file can only be chosen with the file picker.
errors.credentials_fetch_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {tunnel} is the tunnel name (vrcinema), {reason} what cloudflared said.
errors.credentials_invalid: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the tunnel credentials file is unusable.
errors.credentials_save_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {reason} is the system error.
errors.data_dir_in_use: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server start; two servers on one data folder would wipe each other's files.
errors.deno_unpack_failed: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools install; a cause (system error) may follow after a colon. Deno is a program name.
errors.device_blocked: API error (request page). The owner blocked the viewer's device; its requests are refused.
errors.dns_route_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {hostname} is the chosen address, {reason} what cloudflared said.
errors.dns_taken: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the chosen address already has a DNS record; the window then offers to replace it.
errors.domain_blocked: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the link is from a site the owner has blocked.
errors.domain_not_allowed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the link is from a site not on the list; {domains} is a comma-separated list of domains.
errors.download_failed: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools download and update; a cause (network error) may follow after a colon.
errors.download_failed_status: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools download; {status} is the HTTP status number.
errors.download_incomplete: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools download; the byte counts are numbers.
errors.download_interrupted: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools download; a cause (network error) may follow after a colon.
errors.download_unexpected_range: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools download; the server answered a resumed download with the wrong part of the file.
errors.duplicate_link: API error. Request page only (informal): reason next to a link or playlist entry that appears twice in the viewer's list.
errors.empty_json_body: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Technical; the same English text in every language (API compatibility).
errors.empty_playlist: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: an added playlist has no playable entries.
errors.engine_unavailable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel player controls (pause, seek, restart, play now) while the channel loop is busy or restarting.
errors.env_file_unreadable: Error text printed to the console by the headless server or the setup command (also shown in the log). {detail} is the system error.
errors.failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): an operation ended unexpectedly; {detail} is a technical cause. Also the generic message of the error code "failed".
errors.fetch_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the link could not be read; {reason} is a message from yt-dlp or the site (often English) or another errors.* message.
errors.ffmpeg_missing: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: encoder test without ffmpeg installed.
errors.ffmpeg_unpack_failed: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Tools install; a cause (system error) may follow after a colon. ffmpeg is a program name.
errors.field_not_boolean: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Malformed settings request; {field} is an API field name.
errors.field_not_text: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Malformed settings request; {field} is an API field name.
errors.file_missing: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Files from disk: the file is gone; {name} is a file name.
errors.file_paths_unavailable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Files dropped on the window are not supported in this mode.
errors.folder_unreadable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: a media folder cannot be read.
errors.folder_unreadable_detail: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk; {detail} is the system error.
errors.github_bad_answer: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Update check; a cause may follow after a colon.
errors.github_status: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Update check; {status} is the HTTP status number.
errors.github_unreachable: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Update check; a cause (network error) may follow after a colon.
errors.home_unknown: Error text (shown in a message box at start-up). VRCINEMA_HOME and LOCALAPPDATA are names of environment variables, keep them.
errors.hostname_invalid: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the typed address is not a valid host name; the example may be adapted.
errors.hostname_required: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): no address was typed; the example may be adapted.
errors.internal: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Unexpected server failure (details only in the log).
errors.invalid: Permanent-link wizard (app window): a malformed request; also the generic text of the code invalid.
errors.invalid_device_key: API error (request page). The device key sent with a request is not 32 hexadecimal characters (a bug of the page, not something the viewer typed).
errors.invalid_disk_file_url: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Files from disk: malformed internal file address.
errors.invalid_json: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Technical; the same English text in every language (API compatibility).
errors.invalid_language: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Settings; the language setting named a language the program does not have.
errors.invalid_link: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page and panel: the text entered is not an http(s) link.
errors.invalid_path: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: a malformed path.
errors.invalid_port: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: the port field.
errors.invalid_public_url: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: the public address field.
errors.invalid_settings: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: the request is not an object of settings.
errors.invalid_tunnel_mode: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings; quick and named are API values — keep them.
errors.invalid_vaapi_device: API error (panel or app window notice). Settings → Tools, VA-API device field. VA-API and the path are technical names, keep them.
errors.invalid_url: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). {url} is the link that could not be parsed.
errors.item_finished: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: removing a queue item that already played.
errors.item_id_required: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel "play now" with a malformed request; itemId is an API field name — keep it.
errors.item_not_playable: Error text (written to the log). The owner asked to play a queue item that is not in a state that allows it; {status} is a technical word (playing, removed, ...), keep it.
errors.library_disabled: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Headless server panel; MEDIA_DIRS and .env are names — keep them.
errors.list_full: API error. Request page only (informal): reason next to a video of a list that did not fit, because one list may add only so many videos.
errors.live_item: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel player controls while a live stream plays.
errors.live_owner_only: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: a viewer sent a live stream link.
errors.local_address: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the link points to the owner's local network or computer (also an item error when the video address found for a viewer's link is such).
errors.local_files_disabled: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A disk file was requested without media folders; MEDIA_DIRS and .env are names — keep them.
errors.local_not_a_video: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: the chosen file is not a video; {name} is the file name.
errors.login_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {reason} is what cloudflared said (English) or named.no_reason.
errors.login_interrupted: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {reason} is the system error.
errors.login_no_certificate: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the login ended without a certificate.
errors.login_required: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel request without a valid session.
errors.login_timeout: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {duration} is a duration like "5 min" (units.*).
errors.lookup_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the name of the site in the link could not be looked up in time (also an item error for the video address).
errors.move_only_queued: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: moving an item that is not queued.
errors.named_files_left: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): deleting the permanent link left files behind; {detail} is the system error.
errors.named_link_first: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: switching to the permanent link before setting it up; the path names the window's sections — use their translated names.
errors.named_operation_running: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings → Tools: updating cloudflared while the permanent-link wizard runs.
errors.nick_no_pin: API error (panel). The owner tried to reset the PIN of a nick that has none (Settings → Channel → Viewer nicks).
errors.nick_not_found: API error (panel). The nick to release or block is not held by anyone (already released).
errors.nick_pin_invalid: API error (request page). The PIN a viewer chose is neither 4–8 digits nor a passphrase of at least 8 characters. Informal.
errors.nick_pin_locked: API error (request page). Too many wrong PINs or recovery codes from this viewer or for this nick; the viewer must wait (15 minutes or more). Informal.
errors.nick_pin_no_nick: API error (request page). The viewer opened the PIN form with an empty nick field. Informal.
errors.nick_pin_required: API error (request page). The viewer wants a new PIN for a nick that already has one; the current PIN is asked for. Informal.
errors.nick_pin_weak: API error (request page). The PIN is all the same digit or a run like 1234 or 9876. Informal.
errors.nick_pin_wrong: API error (request page). Adopting a nick on another device failed. Deliberately does not say which part was wrong (the nick, the PIN or the recovery code) nor whether the nick exists. Informal.
errors.nick_reserved: API error (request page). The nick is reserved for the owner (the words for host in every language and look-alike spellings of them) and cannot be used by viewers.
errors.nick_taken: API error (request page). The nick (or a look-alike spelling of it) belongs to another viewer's device, which used it in the last 30 days.
errors.no_cloudflared: Tunnel status and wizard (app window): the cloudflared program is not installed; "Tools" is the name of the settings section.
errors.no_domain: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): the account has no domain or the address is outside it; shown with a help link.
errors.no_domain_record: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): like errors.no_domain, plus the wrong DNS record {record} Cloudflare created.
errors.no_public_address: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App window: the QR code was asked for before the channel has an address.
errors.no_requester: API error (panel, app window notice). Panel: "Remove all from this viewer" on a video the owner added (or an anonymous one without a nick), so there is no viewer to match.
errors.no_segment: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A video player asked for a stream segment that is gone (technical).
errors.no_such_item: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: the queue item does not exist (any more).
errors.no_such_list: API error (panel): approving or rejecting a viewer's list that no longer exists.
errors.no_such_root: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: an unknown media folder.
errors.no_update: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). About: installing an update when none is offered.
errors.no_videos_in_folder: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: adding an empty folder.
errors.not_a_folder: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: listing a file as a folder.
errors.not_a_video_file: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Files dropped on the window: {name} is the file name.
errors.not_logged_in: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): a step needs the Cloudflare login first; the quoted step name must match the wizard's button.
errors.not_pending: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel moderation: approving an item that is not pending.
errors.not_playable_next: API error (panel, app window notice). Panel: "Play next" on a video that is neither in the queue nor in the history.
errors.not_playable_now: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel "play now" on an item that is neither queued nor in the history.
errors.nothing_playing: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel player controls when no video plays.
errors.page_not_found: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A page of the program is missing (technical).
errors.password_first: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: switching on the remote panel without a password.
errors.password_save_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.password_too_short: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: remote panel password; {min} is a number (8).
errors.path_outside_library: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel, files from disk: a path escaping the media folder.
errors.pause_at: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel pause with a malformed position (not a number, negative or past the end of the video); atS is an API field name — keep it.
errors.pixeldrain_bad_answer: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; "pixeldrain" is a site name.
errors.pixeldrain_bad_link: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; /u/ and /l/ are URL parts — keep them.
errors.pixeldrain_connection: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; {detail} is the network error.
errors.pixeldrain_list: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A pixeldrain list was played directly.
errors.pixeldrain_not_video: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; {name} is the file name.
errors.pixeldrain_read: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; {detail} is the network error.
errors.pixeldrain_unavailable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a pixeldrain link; {status} is an HTTP status number.
errors.playlist_owner_only: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: a viewer sent a playlist link.
errors.process_timeout: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). A helper program (yt-dlp) ran too long; {command} is its name.
errors.qr_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App window, share view; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.read_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel: an added link could not be read; {reason} is a message from yt-dlp or the site, or another errors.* message.
errors.remote_panel_off: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Remote panel login page while remote access is off.
errors.restart_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App window "restart channel"; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.restart_interrupted: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server restart; {detail} is the system error.
errors.restart_reverted: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings: new port or network access failed; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.schedule_only_queued: API error (panel, app window notice). Panel: "Start at…" on a video that is no longer in the queue.
errors.seek_seconds: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel seek with a malformed or too large number.
errors.seek_target: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel seek with a malformed request; toS and byS are API field names — keep them.
errors.seek_unknown_length: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel seek backwards in a video of unknown length.
errors.server_aborted: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server start and stop; {detail} is the system error.
errors.server_exited_early: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server start.
errors.server_no_state: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server start; an internal problem.
errors.server_restarting: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Adding files by dropping them on the window while the server restarts.
errors.server_start_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.server_start_timeout: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Server start; {seconds} is a number.
errors.setting_not_boolean: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings; {key} is a setting name.
errors.setting_not_language: API error (panel). Panel channel settings (slate language); {key} is a setting name, {languages} the allowed language codes, comma separated (en, pl, ...) - keep the codes as they are.
errors.setting_not_list: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings; {key} is a setting name.
errors.setting_not_number: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings; {key} is a setting name.
errors.setting_not_one_of: API error (panel). Panel channel settings (info ticker); {key} is a setting name, {values} the allowed values, comma separated (interval, continuous, 60, 120, ...) - keep the values as they are.
errors.settings_not_object: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings: malformed request.
errors.settings_save_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App settings could not be written; {path} is the file, {detail} the system error.
errors.setup_env_example_missing: Error text printed to the console by the headless server or the setup command (also shown in the log). A file name; a cause may follow after a colon.
errors.setup_unknown_option: Error text printed to the console by the headless server or the setup command (also shown in the log). Keep the option names --force, --no-env and --cloudflared.
errors.setup_unsupported_platform: Error text printed to the console by the setup command. {platform} is a system name like linux-x86_64. FFMPEG_PATH, FFPROBE_PATH, YTDLP_PATH and .env are names, keep them.
errors.site_not_supported: Item error (queue, panel and request page). yt-dlp does not support the site of the link.
errors.source_message: A message from outside the program (yt-dlp, a website, the system), shown as it is; used as {reason} in other messages. Keep just the field.
errors.ticker_message_too_long: API error (panel). Panel channel settings, info ticker messages; {key} is the setting name, {max} a number (200).
errors.ticker_too_many_messages: API error (panel). Panel channel settings, info ticker messages; {key} is the setting name, {max} a number (10).
errors.timeout: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): a cloudflared command took too long.
errors.too_long: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page; {limit} is a duration like "2 h 0 min" (units.*).
errors.too_many_active: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: the viewer reached the limit of queued videos; {count} is that limit. (Polish keeps the original wording in every form for API compatibility.)
errors.too_many_logins: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Remote panel login.
errors.too_many_requests: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Request page: rate limit.
errors.tools_busy: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): refused while the tools job replaces cloudflared.
errors.tools_running: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings → Tools: a second download was started.
errors.tools_unsupported_platform: Error text (shown in the app window, written to the log, printed by the setup command). Tools download; {tool} is a program name, {platform} a system name like linux-aarch64.
errors.trim_not_allowed: API error (panel, app window notice). Panel: "Trim…" on a video that is no longer waiting or playing, or on a live stream.
errors.tunnel_create_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {tunnel} is the tunnel name, {reason} what cloudflared said.
errors.tunnel_delete_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {tunnel} is the tunnel name, {reason} what cloudflared said.
errors.tunnel_folder_failed: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): {reason} is the system error.
errors.tunnel_off: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). App window: restarting the tunnel while it is off.
errors.undo_expired: API error (panel, app window notice). Panel: the owner pressed "Undo" after a bulk removal too late (the program keeps it for about a minute).
errors.unknown_encoder: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings; {encoder} is the value sent.
errors.unknown_setting: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Panel channel settings; {key} is the setting name sent.
errors.unknown_tool: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Settings → Tools; {tool} is the value sent.
errors.unsupported_media_type: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Technical; the same English text in every language (API compatibility).
errors.update_cannot_install: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Self-update; a cause (system error) may follow after a colon. The old version was restored.
errors.update_cannot_install_or_restore: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Self-update; {path} is the saved copy of the old program.
errors.update_cannot_remove_old: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Self-update; a cause (system error) may follow after a colon.
errors.update_cannot_rename: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Self-update; a cause (system error) may follow after a colon.
errors.update_failed: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). About: installing a new version failed; {detail} is a technical cause.
errors.update_running: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). About: a second install was started.
errors.update_sum_mismatch: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Self-update.
errors.update_sum_missing: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Self-update; {file} is a file name.
errors.update_sum_unreadable: Error text (shown in the app window and written to the log). Self-update; {file} is a file name.
errors.update_unavailable: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). About: a build that cannot update itself.
errors.viewer_lists_off: API error. Request page only (informal): the viewer sent a list but the owner has not allowed lists.
errors.window_only: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Remote panel asked for an app-window-only feature.
errors.wrong_password: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Remote panel login.
errors.ytdlp_bad_data: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a link; yt-dlp is a program name.
errors.ytdlp_no_stream: Reason a video failed (history in the panel); yt-dlp is a program name.
errors.ytdlp_unknown: API error (panel, request page or app window notice). Reading a link failed without a reason from yt-dlp.
errors.setting_out_of_range: API error (panel). Channel settings (Settings → Advanced); {key} is a setting name (keep it), {min} and {max} numbers.
errors.setting_not_language_code: API error (panel). Subtitle language setting; {key} is a setting name (keep it); en and pt-BR are language codes (keep them).
history.empty: New interface, History view: shown when there are no finished videos yet.
history.play_next: New interface, History view: button on a finished video; adds it again at the front of the queue (it plays after the current one). Max ~26 characters.
history.play_next_done: New interface: short message after "Play next" in the History view; {title} is the video title.
history.play_now: New interface, History view: button on a finished video; puts it on air at once.
history.retry: New interface, History view: button on a video that failed; puts it on air again.
history.status_failed: New interface, History view: label of a video that could not be played.
history.status_played: New interface, History view: label of a video that was played to the end.
history.status_skipped: New interface, History view: label of a video that was skipped before its end.
history.sub: New interface, History view: explanation under the title. "Play now" is the name of the button.
history.title: New interface: title of the History view (the same word as the left rail).
history.to_queue: New interface, History view: button that adds the video's link to the queue again.
history.to_queue_local: New interface, History view: tooltip of the disabled "Add to queue" button on a file from the owner's disk.
item_errors.ffmpeg_exit: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel); ffmpeg is a program name, {code} its exit code.
item_errors.ffmpeg_stopped: Reason a video failed, kept with it in the history (panel). ffmpeg is a program name. Short.
item_errors.internal: Reason a video failed (it kept crashing the channel), kept in the history. Short.
item_errors.no_video: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel).
item_errors.probe_failed: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel); ffprobe is a program name and printed no reason.
item_errors.skipped: Kept with a skipped video in the history (panel). Impersonal, short (max ~30 characters).
item_errors.stalled: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel).
item_errors.start_timeout: Reason a video failed, kept in the history (panel).
item_errors.unknown: Reason a video failed without a known cause, kept in the history. Short.
library.title: New interface, Channel view of a server without a window (headless, MEDIA_DIRS set): heading of the block under the link field that lists the video files in the folders the server may play from. Short heading (shown in capitals).
library.folder: Files on disk (headless server): accessible name of the list that picks one of the root folders (MEDIA_DIRS). One word.
library.root: Files on disk (headless server): the line that says where the list is, while it shows the top of a root folder (the same term as in errors.no_such_root).
library.you_are_in: Files on disk (headless server): the line that says which folder the list shows; {path} is the folder's path inside the root folder, with / between the folders.
library.up: Files on disk (headless server): button above the list that goes back to the folder that contains this one. Short button text.
library.add: Files on disk (headless server): small button at the end of a video file's row that adds that file to the queue. Short button text (the panel is narrow).
library.add_folder: Files on disk (headless server): button next to the root folder list that adds every video file of the folder shown (not its subfolders). Disabled when the folder has no video files.
library.empty: Files on disk (headless server): shown instead of the list when the folder has neither video files nor subfolders.
library.size: Files on disk (headless server): size of a video file in its row; {size} is a number with two decimals in the language's number format (e.g. 1.50 / 1,50). Keep the unit short.
log.auto_pause_no_viewers: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The channel paused itself.
log.auto_pause_no_viewers_end: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The channel went on.
log.auto_pause_tunnel: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The channel paused itself.
log.auto_pause_tunnel_end: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The channel went on.
log.autostart_refresh_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the system error.
log.bad_segment_skipped: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A piece of the stream was unusable.
log.banner_admin: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start-up banner line; keep the leading spaces and align the address with the other banner lines.
log.banner_builtin_tunnel: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start-up banner line; keep the leading spaces. It points to the entry log.tunnel_online.
log.banner_lan: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start-up banner line; keep the leading spaces.
log.banner_local_link: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start-up banner line; keep the leading spaces.
log.banner_on: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start-up banner line; keep the leading spaces.
log.banner_public_needed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start-up banner line of the headless server; an example command follows. Keep the leading spaces.
log.banner_requests: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start-up banner line; keep the leading spaces.
log.banner_vrchat_link: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start-up banner line; keep the leading spaces.
log.cannot_create_dir: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the system error.
log.channel_command_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.channel_command_skipped: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {command} is an internal name, keep it.
log.channel_error: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.channel_error_pause: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.channel_error_seek: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.channel_loop_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The channel restarts itself; {error} is the reason.
log.channel_loop_not_running: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Slates could not be refreshed because the channel is down.
log.channel_not_started: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start of the server without tools.
log.channel_start_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {reason} is why.
log.channel_stop_error: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.clip_action_copy: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The video is copied without re-encoding (a word in log.clip_start).
log.clip_action_transcode: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The video is re-encoded (a word in log.clip_start).
log.clip_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A video failed to start or play; {error} is the reason.
log.clip_no_audio: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.clip_start; keep the leading comma.
log.clip_resume: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.clip_start; keep the leading comma.
log.clip_start: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A video starts airing. {action} is log.clip_action_copy or log.clip_action_transcode; {silent} and {resume} are log.clip_no_audio / log.clip_resume or empty.
log.closing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The server is shutting down.
log.cloudflared_missing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). cloudflared is a program name.
log.cloudflared_retry: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). cloudflared is a program name.
log.command_not_sent: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {command} is an internal name, keep it.
log.config_bad_kept: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.config_corrupt.
log.config_bad_not_kept: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.config_corrupt.
log.config_corrupt: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {kept} is log.config_bad_kept or log.config_bad_not_kept.
log.config_unreadable: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The settings file config.json could not be read.
log.countdown: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The next video has a start time; the stream shows a countdown until then.
log.countdown_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is an error message of the program (already translated).
log.countdown_unavailable: Part of a log entry (the {error} of log.countdown_failed): the program was started without the countdown (only in tests and special setups).
log.encoder_test: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {encoder} is a technical name (libx264, h264_nvenc, ...), keep it.
log.light_profile: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Also printed by the headless server at start on a Raspberry Pi. H.264, ARM, 720p30, 720p are technical names. Name the settings section as the rail does.
log.fake_resolver: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Developer test mode; {path} is a file.
log.files_add_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Files dropped on the window; {error} is the reason.
log.files_added: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Files dropped on the window; the numbers are counts.
log.generating_slates: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Start of the channel; slates are the still pictures shown between videos.
log.headless_config_error: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Printed to the console by the headless server, not to the log.
log.headless_tools_missing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Printed to the console by the headless server, not to the log. Keep the command "vrcinema setup".
log.headless_unknown_command: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Printed to the console by the headless server, not to the log. Keep the usage line.
log.item_fail_mark_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.item_keeps_crashing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The channel gave up on a video; {count} is a number.
log.job_assign_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.named_job_warning.
log.job_containment_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Headless server start (Windows job object); {error} is the system error.
log.job_create_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.named_job_warning.
log.job_no_breakaway: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.named_job_warning.
log.media_dir_missing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Headless server; MEDIA_DIRS is a setting name, keep it.
log.named_already_gone: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_cert_copied: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_cert_moved: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_cert_save_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_create_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_credentials_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_delete_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_deleted: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_dns_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_dns_routed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_dns_routed_replaced: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_dns_wrong_domain: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_files_removed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_job_warning: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {warning} is log.job_no_breakaway / log.job_create_failed / log.job_assign_failed.
log.named_late_cert_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_late_cert_moved: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_login_cancelled: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_login_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_login_no_certificate: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_login_started: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_login_timeout: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {duration} is a time such as "5 min".
log.named_remove_files_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_tunnel_exists: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.named_tunnel_ready: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.out_point_moved: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The owner moved the end point of the video on air to a later time; the video is restarted from where it was so it does not stop at the old end point.
log.panel_open_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the system error.
log.pause: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {reason} is a technical word (manual, tunnel, no-viewers), keep it.
log.pause_armed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The owner paused at a moment of the Preview the viewers have not got yet: the video goes on to the end of the segment (a few seconds of video) holding {seconds}, then pauses. {from} is where the channel was.
log.pause_manual: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The owner paused the channel.
log.pause_manual_end: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The owner resumed the channel.
log.pause_reason_manual: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Why the channel is paused; lowercase, used in log.pause as {reason}.
log.pause_reason_obs: Log: the reason of a pause, put into "Pause ({reason})…": the OBS stream is on air. Short.
log.obs_unavailable: Log: this server cannot take an OBS stream (no OBS input).
log.obs_skip_ignored: Log: the owner pressed Skip while the OBS stream was on air; it is ignored.
log.obs_starting: Log: an OBS stream arrived and its conversion starts.
log.obs_on_air: Log: the OBS stream went on air.
log.obs_lost: Log: the OBS stream ended; the "be right back" slate airs for {seconds} seconds, then the queue goes on (unless OBS comes back).
log.obs_back_to_queue: Log: OBS did not reconnect within the grace time; the paused video / the queue goes on.
log.obs_failed: Log: the OBS stream could not be converted by ffmpeg; {error} is the reason.
log.obs_ended_early: Log (put into {error} of log.obs_failed): the OBS connection ended before any picture arrived.
log.obs_port_failed: Log: the OBS (RTMP) port could not be opened at {address} (taken by another program, …); it is tried again.
log.obs_listening: Log: the OBS input listens at {address}.
log.obs_connected: Log: OBS started streaming with the right key from {address} (an IP address).
log.obs_disconnected: Log: the OBS client at {address} disconnected.
log.obs_wrong_key: Log: a client at {address} tried to stream with a wrong stream key (the key itself is never logged).
log.obs_locked_out: Log: too many wrong keys from {address}; its connections are refused for {seconds} seconds.
log.obs_busy: Log: a second OBS client at {address} was refused because another one is streaming.
log.pause_reason_no_viewers: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Why the channel is paused; lowercase, used in log.pause as {reason}.
log.pause_reason_tunnel: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Why the channel is paused; lowercase, used in log.pause as {reason}.
log.play_now: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The owner chose a video to play at once.
log.prefetch_retry: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The next video is started about a minute before its turn; that start failed and is repeated once.
log.prepare_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The next video in the queue is looked up ahead of its turn so there is no gap between videos; this time it failed. {error} is an error message of the program (already translated).
log.preview_download_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The window's Preview plays a film from the internet from a file yt-dlp downloads; this download failed. {error} is yt-dlp's message.
log.program_stopped: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The program has stopped cleanly.
log.queue_error_prefetch: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The next video is prepared in advance; {error} is the reason.
log.request_list_received: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A viewer sent a list of links or a playlist. {viewer} is an anonymous tag of 8 hex digits (never an address), keep it as it is; {added} and {skipped} are numbers of videos; {status} is log.status_queued / log.status_pending.
log.request_received: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A viewer asked for a video. {viewer} is an anonymous tag of 8 hex digits (never an address), keep it as it is; {status} is log.status_queued / log.status_pending.
log.restart_failed_reverting: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.resume: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The paused video goes on.
log.seek: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The owner jumped within the video; the numbers are seconds.
log.seek_not_allowed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {request} is an internal description of the jump, keep it.
log.seek_nothing_to_seek: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {request} is an internal description of the jump, keep it.
log.seek_to_end: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A jump to the very end ends the video.
log.seek_to_end_paused: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A jump to the very end of a paused video ends it.
log.segment_source_error: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The channel could not produce the next piece of the stream.
log.server_aborted: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.server_ended_with_error: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.server_error: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). An unexpected error while answering a request.
log.server_restarting: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The server restarts (new port or network setting).
log.server_start_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.server_stop_timeout: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The server was forced to stop.
log.server_without_channel: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {url} is the admin panel address.
log.session_secret_missing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Headless server start; SESSION_SECRET and .env are names, keep them.
log.setup_already: Console message of the `vrcinema setup` command. {tool} is a program name.
log.setup_done: Console message of the `vrcinema setup` command.
log.setup_env_created: Console message of the `vrcinema setup` command. Keep the names .env, .env.example and ADMIN_PASSWORD.
log.setup_installing: Console message of the `vrcinema setup` command. {tool} is a program name.
log.skip_server_down: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Tray menu "skip".
log.slate_empty: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {kind} is a technical word (idle, buffering, pause).
log.slate_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {kind} is a technical word (idle, buffering, pause).
log.slate_qr_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.slate_failed.
log.slate_qr_save_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.slate_failed.
log.slates_font_missing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {path} is the font file path. FONT_FILE is a setting name in the .env file - keep it as is.
log.slates_japanese_font_missing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Shown when the slate language is Japanese but Windows has no Japanese font; the slates then stay in English. YuGothM.ttc and meiryo.ttc are file names - keep them.
log.slates_refresh_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {reason} is why.
log.slates_refreshed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Written whenever a new slate set goes on air: for a new public address, a new slate language or while the tunnel connects, so it names no reason. {generation} is a number.
log.start: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). First entry of a run; {version} is the program version.
log.started_after_update: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The program was restarted by its own update.
log.status_failed: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Status of a queue item; lowercase, fits after "(".
log.status_pending_approval: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Status of a queue item; lowercase, fits after "(".
log.status_played: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Status of a queue item; lowercase, fits after "(".
log.status_playing: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Status of a queue item; lowercase, fits after "(".
log.status_queued: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Status of a queue item; lowercase, fits after "(".
log.status_rejected: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Status of a queue item; lowercase, fits after "(".
log.status_removed: Word used inside log entries (Settings, Log tab). Status of a queue item; lowercase, fits after "(".
log.stop_too_slow: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The program is quitting; {seconds} is a number with a decimal.
log.ticker_applied: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The owner changed how the info ticker looks; the video on air is restarted from where it was so the change shows at once.
log.ticker_failed_plain: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). ffmpeg failed to draw the info ticker (e.g. a broken font); the video is started again without it. {error} is ffmpeg's message.
log.ticker_font_missing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The font file for the info ticker is missing; {path} is a file path. FONT_FILE and .env are names - keep them.
log.ticker_live_next_item: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The owner changed how the info ticker looks while a live stream airs.
log.ticker_slow: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The conversion that drawing the info ticker needs is slower than real time; {speed} is a number like 0.85.
log.ticker_text_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is a system error.
log.tools_error: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason a tools job could not start.
log.tools_job_done: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {what} is log.tools_job_install / update / repair.
log.tools_job_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {what} is log.tools_job_install / update / repair; {error} is the reason.
log.tools_job_install: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A word in log.tools_job_done / log.tools_job_failed: the tools were being downloaded.
log.tools_job_repair: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A word in log.tools_job_done / log.tools_job_failed: the tools were being repaired.
log.tools_job_update: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). A word in log.tools_job_done / log.tools_job_failed: a tool was being updated.
log.tools_no_checksums: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {tool} is a program name.
log.tools_resumed_file_mismatch: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {file} is a file name.
log.tray_copy_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the system error.
log.tray_create_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the system error.
log.tray_menu_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The tray menu could not follow a change of language; {error} is the system error.
log.tunnel_connection_lost: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.tunnel_describe_named: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_started; {credentials} is a file path.
log.tunnel_describe_quick: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_started.
log.tunnel_exit_code: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_reason_exited.
log.tunnel_exit_no_code: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_reason_exited.
log.tunnel_online: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The public address of the channel.
log.tunnel_reason_exited: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_retry; {code} is log.tunnel_exit_code or log.tunnel_exit_no_code.
log.tunnel_reason_exited_with_output: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_retry; {output} is its last line, in English.
log.tunnel_reason_no_address: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_retry.
log.tunnel_reason_no_connection: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_retry.
log.tunnel_reason_rate_limited: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_retry; keep "429 Too Many Requests".
log.tunnel_reason_start_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Part of log.tunnel_retry; starts with a lowercase letter.
log.tunnel_retry: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {reason} is one of the log.tunnel_reason_* entries.
log.tunnel_started: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {config} is log.tunnel_describe_quick or log.tunnel_describe_named.
log.tunnel_stopped: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.tunnel_warning: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {warning} is a tunnel status note.
log.update_available: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.update_check_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.update_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.update_installed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.update_installing: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text).
log.window_controls_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The minimize/maximize/close buttons of the window's own title bar; {error} is the system error.
log.window_create_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the system error.
log.window_follows_port: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The port changed; {port} is a number.
log.window_switch_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the system error.
log.ytdlp_client: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). Diagnostics when a YouTube video starts: {client} is the name of the YouTube client yt-dlp used (e.g. TVHTML5, VISIONOS; keep as it is); yt-dlp was given a JavaScript runtime (Deno).
log.ytdlp_client_no_js: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). As log.ytdlp_client, but yt-dlp had no JavaScript runtime.
log.ytdlp_fallback_client: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). YouTube answered HTTP 403 to the address yt-dlp gave; the program asks yt-dlp again for another YouTube client. {client} and {fallback} are client names (keep as they are).
log.ytdlp_update: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The last line yt-dlp printed when updating itself; {line} is in English from the program, keep the entry as it is.
log.ytdlp_update_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is the reason.
log.alarm_black: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The black picture alarm went off; {seconds} is a number of seconds.
log.alarm_silence: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). The silence alarm went off; {seconds} is a number of seconds.
log.journal_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {error} is a database error.
log.subtitles_none: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {lang} is a language code like en, {title} a video title.
log.subtitles_failed: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). {title} is a video title, {error} yt-dlp's message.
log.subtitles_failed_plain: Log entry (Settings, Log tab; the log file on disk keeps the English text). ffmpeg failed to draw the burned-in subtitles; the video is started again without them. {id} is a number, {error} ffmpeg's message.
login.hint: Sign-in screen of the remote panel, under the heading. 'Settings → Remote panel' names the place in the program; keep the arrow.

login.window_hint: Text under login.window_title. 'Notification area' is the Windows system tray.

named.deleted: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): result notice after deleting the permanent link; {hostname} is its address.
named.deleted_no_host: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): like named.deleted when the address is not known.
named.logged_in: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): result of step 1 (login).
named.logged_in_before: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): result of step 1 when an older certificate was reused; .cloudflared is a folder name.
named.no_reason: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): used as {reason} when cloudflared printed nothing.
named.ready: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): result of step 2; {url} is the new address.
named.step.creating_tunnel: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line; {tunnel} is the tunnel name.
named.step.deleting: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line.
named.step.fetching_credentials: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line.
named.step.routing_dns: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line; {hostname} is the chosen address.
named.step.starting: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line.
named.step.switching: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line.
named.step.waiting_for_browser: Permanent-link wizard (app window, Settings → Internet): progress line while the browser login page is open.
monitor.ahead: New interface, Channel view: caption above the left screen ("Preview": the newest material the server has, before the viewers see it). {seconds} is how far it is ahead of what is on air, rounded. Max ~56 characters (a longer one is cut with …).
monitor.air_behind: New interface, Channel view: caption of the On air screen while the Preview plays the video itself. {seconds} is how far the viewers' picture (estimated by the engine from the viewers' requests) is behind the Preview, whole seconds. Max ~60 characters.
monitor.in_sync: New interface, Channel view: caption above the left screen when it shows what is on air now (after "Sync with on-air"). Max ~56 characters (a longer one is cut with …).
monitor.label: New interface, Channel view: screen-reader name of the left screen.
monitor.mute: New interface, Channel view: button (screen-reader label and tooltip) beside the caption of the left screen "Preview"; it starts muted. Not the sound of the on-air screen (player.mute).
monitor.none: New interface, Channel view: shown in the left screen while no video is being prepared or played (slates, empty queue). Max ~30 characters.
monitor.on_air: New interface, Channel view: caption of the On air screen (what the viewers see; the right one, on a phone the only one) while its delay is not measured yet. Max ~30 characters.
monitor.obs_live: New interface, Preview: note over the picture while the OBS stream is on air (no seeking).
monitor.on_air_caption: New interface, Channel view: caption of the On air screen (the channel as the viewers get it; the right one, on a phone the only one). {seconds} is its measured delay, rounded. Max ~60 characters.
monitor.paused: New interface, Channel view: label over the still picture of the left screen while the channel is paused. Max ~50 characters.
monitor.sync: New interface, Channel view: button under the left screen; the left screen then shows what the viewers see now (key S). Max ~34 characters.
monitor.sync_live: New interface, Channel view: tooltip of the disabled "Sync with on-air" button while a live stream plays.
monitor.sync_unavailable: New interface, Channel view: short message after "Sync with on-air" when the segments the viewers see are no longer kept (e.g. right after a skip).
monitor.title: New interface, Channel view: caption above the left screen while nothing is measured, and its name in the remote panel. Max ~30 characters.
monitor.unmute: New interface, Channel view: the same button as monitor.mute while the left screen is muted.
monitor.unavailable: New interface, Channel view: message over the left screen "Preview" when it could not be played after several tries (a "Try again" button follows).
monitor.unsupported: New interface, Channel view: shown in the left screen "Preview" when the window's browser engine cannot play HLS (no Media Source Extensions).
nav.channel: New interface, left rail: label under the icon of the main view (Preview and On air screens, up next, add link). Max ~12 characters (72 px wide rail).
nav.history: New interface, left rail: label of the view with the videos that already played. Max ~12 characters.
nav.label: New interface, left rail: accessible name of the list of views (read by screen readers, not shown).
nav.pending: New interface, left rail: tooltip and screen-reader text of the red counter on "Channel" (videos added by viewers that need the owner's approval).
nav.settings: New interface, left rail: label of the settings view (bottom of the rail). Max ~13 characters; a soft hyphen (U+00AD) may be used to allow a break.
nav.share: New interface, left rail: label of the view with the channel link, the request page and its QR code. Max ~12 characters.
net.connecting: New interface, player bar: status pill while the tunnel connects. Max ~16 characters.
net.local: New interface, player bar: status pill when the tunnel is off and there is no public address. Max ~16 characters.
net.manual: New interface, player bar: status pill when the tunnel is off and the owner typed a public address. Max ~16 characters.
net.offline: New interface, player bar: status pill when the tunnel is lost or failed. Max ~16 characters.
net.online: New interface, player bar: green status pill — the channel is reachable from the internet. Max ~16 characters.

permalink.back_quick: New interface, permanent link: button that switches to the quick tunnel.
permalink.cancel: New interface, permanent link wizard: button.
permalink.close: New interface, permanent link wizard: button shown when it is done.
permalink.connect: New interface, permanent link wizard, step 1: button. Cloudflare is a company name, keep it.
permalink.create: New interface, permanent link wizard, step 2: button.

permalink.creating: New interface, permanent link wizard: progress message.
